info.title: Create First Mile Bundle
info.description: If you send multiple packages to TikTok Shop warehouse in a single first-mile bundle, you can use the API to create a first-mile bundle on TikTok Shop and get the bundle ID.

post.description: If you send multiple packages to TikTok Shop warehouse in a single first-mile bundle, you can use the API to create a first-mile bundle on TikTok Shop and get the bundle ID.

parameters.name: x-tts-access-token
parameters.description: The seller access_token value from [Get Access Token](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/678e3a3292b0f40314a92d75#Get%20Access%20Token%20API), when user_type = 0. Follow this [guide](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/678e3a344ddec3030b238fa0) to get seller access_token.

parameters.name: app_key
parameters.description: Every single app will have a unique key. Please use the specific key assigned to your app.

parameters.name: sign
parameters.description: Signature generated by gen algorithm. When you send API requests to TTS, you must sign them so that TTS can identify the senders.

parameters.name: timestamp
parameters.description: Unix timestamp GMT (UTC+00:00). This timestamp is used across all API requests. Developers can use this convert to local time.

parameters.name: body
parameters.description: Request body. Full source table is retained in x-tiktok-request-body-parameters.

order_ids.description:
The IDs of all the orders sent in a single first-mile bundle.
The orders must follow the restrictions:
- Each of the orders must exist and be RTS and shipping label printed.
- The orders are sent by the same seller.
- The orders belong to a single group of TikTok Shop service districts. The groups are:
  - Group 1: PH, SG, MY, VN, TH, and JP.
  - Group 2: DE, FR, IT, ES.

You can not create first mile bundles for US/UK orders using this API.

handover_method.description:
The way you send the first-mile bundle. Possible enumerations are:
- `PICKUP`: You use the logistic service provided by TikTok Shop to send the bundle.
- `DROP_OFF`: You contact the logistic provider and send the bundle. The logistic provider must be registered at TikTok Shop.

shipping_provider_id.description: The logistic provider ID in TikTok Shop. Required when `handover_method == DROP_OFF`.

tracking_number.description: The logistic tracking number of the bundle. Required when `handover_method == DROP_OFF`.

phone_tail_number.description: Last 4 digits of the sender's phone number. Required when `handover_method == DROP_OFF`.

200.description: Successful response. See source Markdown for complete semantics.

code.description: The success or failure status code returned in API response.

message.description: The success or failure messages returned in API response. Reasons of failure will be described in the message.

first_mile_bundle_id.description: The ID of the first-mile bundle.
